name: n8n_enforced_lanes_have_output_rule_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: N8N_ENFORCED_LANES_HAVE_OUTPUT_RULE_20261107 — 2026-11-02 conflict-resolver live: the allowlist armed
the lane for output enforcement on 2026-10-29 (42e3211cd, output_receipt v2) while its health contract had no
expected_output block; apply_output_verdict stamped rule_missing on five healthy exit-0 runs (status ok,
produced_count 1), which grades RUN_FAILED, and the breaker opened 2026-11-02T14:15:59Z. The rule itself only
landed 2026-11-05 (0a540a987, PR 2368). Nothing compared the two configs, so the ordering defect was
invisible until the runs failed. This gate makes the pairing a build-time invariant: every allowlist lane
with output_receipt v2 must have a kind=lane contract carrying an expected_output block, through the
executor's own loaders (load_allowlist / parse_expected_outputs). Synthetic fixtures only.
